units: <cite ref="Taanit 9b:2">Taan. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>רחמנא לִיצְּלַן</he>, v. <cite ref="K00583"><he>כִּיסּוּפָא</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 72b:18">Snh. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא מצי אַצּוּלֵיה</he> when he cannot save him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 115a:5">Sabb. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>השתא אַצּוּלֵי מַצִּילִינָן וכ׳</he> since we are bound to save them (on the Sabbath), is it necessary to say that they require burying (when defective)?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:16">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ומִתַּצְּלַת</he> and thou shalt be saved.
